perEntry.judgment: Retains astronomy, molecular biology/genetics, chemical industry and all named earth sciences. Removes obsolete quarter-century-relative dating and superlative; space instruments, not compulsory human spaceflight, explain atmospheric access.

All named sectors remain. Nuclear generation is an additional energy pathway, not inevitable conversion of every fossil-fuel plant; materials, mechanization, automation and performance benefits are appropriately qualified.
Preserves knowledge-to-production through inventions and application, with practical conditions instead of a deterministic social slogan.
Production improvement and material needs remain in the original position. Political inevitability is explicitly neutralized; no political theory is presented as a law of physics.
Retains the foundational role of physics and transition to the actual ensuing examples without ranking sciences.

Visible/radio observations, neutrinos, solar interior and particle/nuclear foundations remain. Solar reactions and flavour change agree with Nobel2015; CERN supports the unresolved asymmetry qualification. Does not claim neutrino astronomy proved an antiworld. The old twenty-year date is not recast as a current date.

NASA supports absorption and atmospheric windows. UV/IR/x/gamma bands, primary cosmic rays and astrophysics remain. Rejects exhaustive particle detection and an undefined information-total comparison; does not say all IR is blocked at ground level.

Correctly distinguishes molecular basis of life from living molecules. Keeps x-ray structural analysis, electron imaging, neutron analysis, isotope tracing and ultracentrifugation, with distinct purposes and physical principles. Electron/proton microscopy wording becomes electron microscopy plus a charged-particle-beam category; this is declared modernization, not an inferred source glyph repair or proof that proton microscopes are routine biological tools. See limitation L1.
Chemistry, geology, oceanography and other sciences remain; unsupported comparative primacy becomes a contribution of theories and methods.
Energy, communication, transport, construction and industrial/agricultural production remain. Physics is a foundation, not the exclusive origin of every technical improvement.

Million-scale comparison is scientifically reasonable on the explicitly equal-mass complete-fission versus coal-combustion basis, not plant output/efficiency. Both languages retain coal/oil/gas, uranium/thorium and conservation concerns. Resource accessibility, fuel-cycle conditions, waste and safety qualify old absolute advantages; WNA is used only for fuel-cycle principles, not commercial forecasts.

DOE supports fusion potential and multidisciplinary confinement/engineering challenges. Removes permanent-energy-security promise and exclusive dependence on nuclear physics without dropping the fusion topic.

Preserves designed material properties, chemical cooperation and the full electron/ion/laser/field/pressure/temperature/ultrasound list. Materials still need feedstocks; extreme conditions do not guarantee universal transformation.

Preserves production-state measurement, monitoring and electronic control with radio electronics/solid-state foundations. Nuclear methods are appropriately restricted to some measurements, not every automation instrument.

Vacuum tubes/transistors/integrated circuits remain in source order as early historical generations, not the endpoint of computing. Size/speed/reliability and footnote marker remain. Gabor supports coherent optical recording/reconstruction; computing remains a research potential, not a proven deployed holographic replacement.

perEntry.judgment: ASML supports patterned layers and semiconductor-property modification, not a generic molecular-film explanation. Preserves the interior/surface alternatives and match-head illustration while distinguishing a circuit chip from a complete radio including external components. Exact source character and footnote identity remain unchanged.
Retains nonexhaustive synthesis and substantial contribution of physics. Neutralizes decisive-cause rhetoric; no exact historical emphasis or rendered-bold approval is inferred.

Retains basic natural laws, further science/technology and human needs. Distribution and guaranteed social ideals are distinguished from technological capability; no ideology is asserted as scientific consequence.

limitations.detail: Nobel2017/OpenStax directly support biomolecular electron imaging and the cell/life distinction. They do not independently document the full neutron/tracer/centrifugation list or a specific proton-beam biological application. The unchanged categories were judged at the lesson's introductory level; the charged-particle phrase is a broad disclosed generalization, not a newly verified specialist technique. No confirmed false statement or missing instructional category follows from this evidence limit. Do not cite these two pages as comprehensive proof of the whole list.

Saved reference texts support selected modernizations, not every generic sentence or quantitative derivation. No independent experimental result, reference calculation, latest reactor/computer status, whole-source glyph or displayed layout is certified.
